verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. The full integer multiplier-ideal tower and the full divisorial Lelong profile determine each other via the exact log-discrepancy squeeze. Choquet's lemma, simultaneous very-general-point selection on each divisor, and monotone convergence of point Lelong numbers show that the envelope stays in the same realizable I-class; maximality then gives the normalized fixed I-model and its uniqueness, with no mass hypothesis. In the P^1 construction, the chosen generalized Cantor set is polar, its uniform Cantor measure is diffuse, and its Green potential has zero divisorial Lelong profile. Consequently all scaled multiplier ideals are trivial, while the degree-one nonpluripolar product discards the polar-supported measure and has mass 1-s. All cited results were checked with matching definitions, normalizations, hypotheses, and downstream uses. No critical error or gap was found.
